nodes.name: Basic Plumbing Tools Knowledge
nodes.description: Understand the names, uses, and safety procedures for common plumbing tools (e.g., pipe wrenches, pipe cutters, soldering torches).

nodes.name: Pipe Fitting Basics
nodes.description: Learn about different pipe materials (copper, PVC, PEX), common fittings (elbows, tees, couplings), and basic connection methods.

nodes.name: Water System Understanding
nodes.description: Gain knowledge of water supply systems, including water pressure, drainage, and common plumbing codes.

nodes.name: Reading Blueprints
nodes.description: Develop the ability to interpret plumbing blueprints and schematics to understand the layout and requirements of a plumbing system.

nodes.name: Complete First Basic Installation
nodes.description: Successfully install a simple plumbing fixture (e.g., a sink or toilet) according to blueprints and safety regulations.

nodes.name: Be more calm when something stressful happens
Daily Mindfulness Meditation Practice
nodes.description: Establish a consistent daily practice of mindfulness meditation, focusing on breath awareness and non-judgmental observation of thoughts and feelings.

nodes.name: Identify and Label Emotions
nodes.description: Develop the ability to accurately identify and label your emotions as they arise, increasing self-awareness and reducing reactivity.

nodes.name: Implement Simple Stress Reduction Techniques
nodes.description: Learn and practice simple stress reduction techniques such as deep breathing exercises, progressive muscle relaxation, or grounding techniques.

nodes.name: Respond Calmly to Stressful Situations
nodes.description: After experiencing a stressful situation, utilize learned techniques to respond with calmness and composure, minimizing emotional reactivity and promoting a sense of control.

nodes.name: Be more outgoing and talk to more people
Openers & Conversation Starters
nodes.description: Learn and practice various conversation starters to initiate interactions.

nodes.name: Active Listening Techniques
nodes.description: Develop skills in active listening – paying attention, showing understanding, and responding thoughtfully.

nodes.name: Reading Body Language
nodes.description: Understand and interpret nonverbal cues (facial expressions, posture, gestures) to improve communication.

nodes.name: Building Rapport
nodes.description: Learn techniques for establishing connection and trust with others.

nodes.name: Attend 3 Meetups & Initiate 5 Conversations
nodes.description: Attend three social events and actively initiate five conversations with new people.

nodes.name: Basic Communication Skills
nodes.description: Develop fundamental communication skills, including active listening and clear articulation.

nodes.name: Introduction to Time Management
nodes.description: Learn basic time management techniques like prioritization and scheduling.

nodes.name: Setting SMART Goals
nodes.description: Understand and apply the SMART goal framework (Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, Time-bound).

nodes.name: Introduction to Adaptability
nodes.description: Explore the importance of adaptability in a changing work environment and identify personal strengths.

nodes.name: Complete a Small Project
nodes.description: Successfully complete a small, manageable project demonstrating the application of learned skills.

nodes.name: Hypertrophy Training - Foundation
nodes.description: Establish proper form and movement patterns for basic weightlifting exercises. Focus on mastering the fundamentals.

nodes.name: Squat Form
nodes.description: Learn and practice the correct form for the barbell back squat.

nodes.name: Bench Press Form
nodes.description: Learn and practice the correct form for the barbell bench press.

nodes.name: Volume Progression
nodes.description: Understand and implement a systematic approach to increasing weight and reps over time.

nodes.name: Complete First Workout
nodes.description: Successfully complete a structured workout routine incorporating the learned exercises and volume progression techniques.

nodes.name: Office Productivity Tools
nodes.description: Gain proficiency in using common office productivity tools like Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

nodes.name: Financial Literacy Fundamentals
nodes.description: Understand basic financial concepts, including budgeting, saving, and investing.

nodes.name: Accounting Principles
nodes.description: Learn the core principles of accounting, including GAAP and financial reporting.

nodes.name: Complete a Basic Financial Task
nodes.description: Successfully complete a simple financial task, such as creating a basic budget or reconciling bank statements.

nodes.name: Conversation Starters
nodes.description: Learn simple, open-ended questions and topics to initiate conversations.

nodes.name: Active Listening
nodes.description: Develop the ability to fully focus on what others are saying, understanding their message, and responding thoughtfully.

nodes.name: Empathy
nodes.description: Understand and share the feelings of others.  Recognize perspectives different from your own.

nodes.name: Nonverbal Communication
nodes.description: Become aware of and interpret body language, facial expressions, and tone of voice to better understand communication.

nodes.name: Have a 5-Minute Conversation with a Stranger
nodes.description: Initiate and maintain a brief conversation with someone you don't know, demonstrating basic social skills.

nodes.name: Rapport Building
nodes.description: Finding common ground and creating a sense of connection.

nodes.name: Have a 5-minute conversation
nodes.description: Engage in a 5-minute conversation with a new person, asking open-ended questions and actively listening to their responses.
